'''Michael Wittin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2002 Melbourne tournament]] on 6 January 2002 with LSC, according to Ronnie Wilcox's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3235">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-06-melbourne-whats-todays-dated3235/ melbourne-whats-todays-date], DeckTech (Ronnie "AD-fig" Wilcox, 6 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-06-melbourne-whats-todays-dated3235/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
